about: Hand labels of the FIRST drafts of the Copilot 3.3 TEST split (frozen question set, sha256 83ed77d6...; drafts from the deployed 3.2 pipeline, eval/copilot33_answers_baseline32.json). Labelled on 2026-10-17 AFTER the 3.3 code was frozen (eval/copilot33_code_freeze.json, 09:29) and BEFORE any detector was run on these drafts; draft + tool data only. Same single annotator as dev/val (also the rule author).
